content.short: Alephium is an operational, sharded L1 blockchain that scales PoW and UTXO concepts.
content.description: Alephium is a scalable blockchain that builds on mature Bitcoin-era concepts to deliver reliable, powerful, and secure DeFi and dApps. It uses blockflow sharding to achieve up to 10,000 TPS and a stateful UTXO model for secure, programmable DeFi and dApps. The network emphasizes energy efficiency, drawing only about one-eighth of Bitcoin's energy. It introduces Alphred, a custom VM designed to improve security and developer experience. It also features its own programming language as a user-friendly alternative to Solidity.
